Name: Ace's George
Author: acerbicon
Description:
[size=2][i][center]ATTENTION:
[color=#ff7700]PLEASE[/color][color=#ff0000] DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANYWHERE BUT [/color][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/]NEXUSMODS[/url][color=#ff0000]. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS, UPLOADING THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. PLEASE DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE.[/color][/center][/i][/size]
[i]How to Install: [/i]
[list=1]
[*]Go to your Stardew Valley installation folder.

[*]Back up your Stardew Valley\Contents\Characters\George.xnb and Stadew Valley\Contents\Portraits\George.xnb 

[*]Extract the contents of the .zip file into the Stardew Valley\Contents folder.

[*]Allow the files to overwrite.
[/list]

[i]NO OVERWRITE Install: [/i](Requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url], [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/entoarox-framework.4228/]Entoarox Framework[/url], and [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/xnb-loader.4506/]Xnb Loader[/url])
[list=1]
[*]Go to your Stardew Valley installation folder.
[*]Extract the contents of the .zip file into the Stardew Valley\Mods\XnbLoader\ModContent folder.
[/list]

This never would have happened (probably) without [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/games/users/2543917/?]Jokerine's[/url] kind comments on my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/933/?]Evelyn[/url] overhaul. I hadn't originally planned on doing anything to George (beyond the cleaning up of his stains I'd already done for myself) but here we are! Props to anyone who can figure out who I used as my inspiration for him.

A big thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/ConcernedApe]ConcernedApe[/url] for his wonderful game I've spent many hundreds of hours playing and countless more modifying. And an extra kudos for his original George Portrait and Sprite which was used as the basis for my own modified file.
